::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Set up in 2025 (incorporated in Bengaluru, operations in Hyderabad) by CEO Rajesh Gupta and veterans of TI, Micron and ams OSRAM. Developing an automotive-grade single-chip battery-management SoC for packs above 3 kWh. Pre-silicon.
:::

## What does this firm design?

A single-chip battery-management system (BMS) SoC for EV and energy-storage batteries, and power-conversion ICs.
